date: Late 2024 (post); departure effective January 2025; page closure November 2025
notes: Post date is pre-April 2025 window. The described actions (departure, page closure) extend into the window, but the SOURCE predates it. Peak revenue ~$980/song × 3 songs/month ≈ ~$2,940/month at peak. Bandcamp $20/year as alternative.

extra_fields.subject: 10-year Patreon veteran (since January 2015) announces departure. Peak earnings ~$980/song; at 3 songs/month earned a "passable living." Leaving because Patreon removed per-creation billing model to comply with Apple iOS app requirements. Calls it "completely absurd, insulting, horrifying, and counter to what Patreon claimed to stand for." Moving to Bandcamp subscription at $20/year.
